Subject: Password expiry reminder
Body:
Hi,

Your password will expire in 7 days.
If you’ve forgotten it, use the official portal from the Mondas app.

Thanks,
IT
Explanation: Legit reminder: no link/attachment, no urgency, no credential request in email body.

Subject: URGENT: Account will be locked in 24 hours
Body:
Dear user,

We detected unusual activity.
Verify your account immediately to avoid suspension.

Regards,
Security Team
Explanation: Lookalike sender domain + urgency + push to verify via link.

Subject: Invoice for January (PDF)
Body:
Hi,

Invoice attached for January.
If anything looks off, reply directly.

Thanks,
Finance
Explanation: Plausible internal sender, normal tone, benign PDF attachment.

Subject: Delivery failed: action required
Body:
We attempted delivery today but could not complete it.
Please schedule a redelivery using the link below.

DHL
Explanation: Generic parcel lure + external domain + link prompt.

Subject: Quick favour
Body:
Hey,

Can you quickly review this doc before I send it?
Just open the attachment and tell me if it looks ok.

Cheers
Explanation: Reply-To mismatch + macro-enabled doc (docm) + social engineering.

Subject: Updated employee handbook
Body:
Hi,

We’ve published an updated handbook.
Read it when you get a chance.

Thanks,
HR
Explanation: Legit domain + low pressure + reasonable request.

Subject: Payment declined
Body:
We couldn’t process your payment.
Update billing details to avoid service interruption.
Explanation: External billing domain + pressure to update details via link.

Subject: Security tip: phishing links
Body:
Quick reminder: don’t open unexpected links.
If you’re unsure, report it.

— Mondas Security
Explanation: No action request, no link, informational message.
